name: @gjsify/napi-darwin-arm64
description: darwin-arm64 prebuilt native library + GObject-Introspection typelib for @gjsify/napi. Installed automatically on darwin/arm64 as an optionalDependency of that package (ADR 0017) and skipped everywhere else. Contains no JavaScript.

platformsUncommitted.darwin-arm64: napi.yml's `macos` job builds, load-tests and uploads it as a workflow artifact for a release to ship; no job commits it back into this repo
